title: A map of your practice
description: Where your practice stands on the ladder, which signs show that one-to-one work has become a ceiling, what the client really gets, and where your competence ends.

units.title: Where I stand on the ladder
Through the client's eyes: what they get

objectives.text: Describe your practice by the three axes of the ladder: step, channel and event class.
Tell apart, in your own practice, the signs of “time to step up” from the signs of “too early”.
For each client, separate what they get from the method and what they get from their relationship with you.
Name the signs at which a practitioner stops and refers the client on, and draw up your own referral list.
